snippet.title: Dark Souls - X360 / PS3 - Prologue - Part 2
snippet.description:
Dark Souls : Prologue Video Series Part 2

Stay tuned for more to come on Dark Souls Prologue series ! Enjoy

Part 1 available here: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=isjdSi0eKoc

Dark Souls will be available on Xbox 360 and Playstation 3 on October 4th 2011. For more information, check out the official website http://www.preparetodie.com and on http://www.facebook.com/darksouls

ESRB Rating: MATURE with Blood and Gore, Partial Nudity, Violence
